description: This file contains a benchmarking class for Orleans-based stateless worker grains, including performance measurement, adaptive worker pool management, and related interfaces and base classes.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerBenchmark
classes.description: Main class for benchmarking Orleans stateless worker grains, managing lifecycle, executing load tests, and collecting statistics.

classes.name: BenchmarkConstants
classes.description: Contains constant configuration values for the benchmark such as max workers and process delay.

classes.name: IProcessorGrain
classes.description: Interface for grains that process tasks, with a Process method.

classes.name: IAdaptiveGrain
classes.description: Marker interface for adaptive worker grains.

classes.name: IMonotonicGrain
classes.description: Marker interface for monotonic worker grains.

classes.name: SWMonotonicGrain
classes.description: Stateless worker grain with monotonic behavior, configured with max workers and no idle worker removal.

classes.name: SWAdaptiveGrain
classes.description: Stateless worker grain with adaptive behavior, configured with max workers and idle worker removal.

classes.name: BaseGrain<T>
classes.description: Abstract base class for grains, providing worker count tracking, stats updating, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: StatelessWorkerBenchmark
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Orleans host and grain factory.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Stops and disposes the Orleans host.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Executes benchmark runs for monotonic and adaptive grains.

methods.name: Run<T, H>
methods.description: Performs the load test for a specific grain type, including task scheduling, stats collection, and cooldown periods.

methods.name: UpdateStats
methods.description: Updates worker count statistics and maximums.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the stopwatch and finalizes stats collection.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Simulates task processing with a delay.

methods.name: GetMaxActiveWorkers
methods.description: Returns maximum active worker count observed.

methods.name: GetAverageActiveWorkers
methods.description: Calculates and returns the average number of active workers over time.
